sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1985
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1985
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (FOURTH
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Representation of the People (Fourth
Amendment) Ordinance, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Fourth Amendment Ordinance 1985
sections.description:
Insertion of new section 80-A of Act lxxxv of 1976

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1985
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1985
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (FOURTH
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985
5. Insertion of new section 80A, Act
LXXXV of 1976.‑In the said Act, after section 80, the following new
section shall be inserted, namely :‑
`'80A. Penalty for adversely affecting
the interests, of candidate.‑Who‑
ever, as a proposer, or in a fictitious
name as a prooser, wilfully does any act which he is prohibited by law from
doing, or omits to do any act which he is required by law to do, or makes any
entry in a nomination form which is not correct, or subscribes to a nomination
form a signature which is not genuine, and thereby adversely affects the
interests of any person as a candidate, shall be punishable with imprisonment
for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to
five thousand rupees, or with both.".
